page.title: Journal
page.purpose: Show money events with their provenance, and let an operator add one by hand or correct one with a reversing entry.

priorities.statement: Each event's amount, direction, date and account
Its basis — authoritative, derived, or operator-asserted — beside the number, never inferred from styling
Whether it has been reversed, and by which entry

states.description: The surface at rest with data present — the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
Nothing in flight; the surface is at rest and its controls are usable.
A user-triggered operation is in flight and its outcome is not yet known.
An operation completed; the result is announced, not merely rendered.
First read of the surface's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
A write is in flight; the affected control is disabled and says why.
A background read is refreshing data the user is already looking at.
A user-requested re-read of data already on screen.
The query succeeded and there is genuinely nothing — distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing source could not be read; what is missing is named.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated.
An automatic retry is in progress; attempt count and next attempt are visible.
The caller's role does not permit this; what role would is stated.
The client cannot reach the API; queued or read-only behavior is explained.
This entry has been reversed. Both the original and its reversal remain visible and linked; neither can be edited or deleted.
